description: Lives lost on NT roads (annual and cumulative) is a group of 2 related entries of the DITRDCSA Data Catalogue, listed under the Road Safety Data (National Road Safety Hub) group and published by Department of Infrastructure, Planning and Logistics, NT. Members: Annual Lives Lost on NT Roads; Lives Lost on NT Roads. Example entry: Annual statistics of lives lost on NT roads based on road user type as at December each year. Shows breakdown of demographics of individuals and whether lives were lost on urban or regional roads. Coverage is Australia, 2013 onward; spatial detail follows the source and is not stated in the entry. The catalogue lists the update frequency as annual, the status as current, and the entry was last changed on 2025-02-24. Files and pages listed: HTML (2 resources), reached from the source page and the catalogue entry, with the CKAN API giving the metadata. Access is free of charge and open; the licence is not stated in the catalogue entry (source page not read). Caveats: the record was written from the catalogue metadata only, so the source page was not opened, the file contents were not checked, and many entries are HTML landing pages or PDF reports, not data files. It can support road incident and emergency response analysis and capacity and investment planning studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ditrdcsa-data-catalogue-australia.
